text: Reef Shoshani If they want you to register, you can just go into PIBA to register it (usually no appointment is necessary) - not in the visa section, but in the registry section. You will need to bring the apostilled marriage certificate (translated into Hebrew if not in English/Arabic), and also your partner's apostilled/translated status certificate from before the wedding, plus the MR6 form. If everything is in order, it should be quite easy
